issue.body:
The round75 source investigation supports a qualified **abiotic** waste CRT-glass record from Imre-Lucaci et al. (2021), DOI [10.3390/ma14061546](https://doi.org/10.3390/ma14061546). Two microbial leads remain incomplete and must not be transferred into that record from abstracts or secondary summaries.

- **Pant et al. (2014), [10.1016/j.hydromet.2014.02.016](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.hydromet.2014.02.016)**: complete original methods, figures and relevant supplements were not obtained. Publisher/TDM responses supplied metadata only; other checked routes were closed or request-only. Resolve whether the experimental CRT waste is glass, a specified component or another fraction, and inspect strain identity and EDTA-only/cell-free comparators before adding a microbial mechanism.
- **Beolchini et al. (2012), [10.1016/j.wasman.2011.10.014](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.wasman.2011.10.014), PMID22088958**: the feed is fluorescent powder from CRT-glass recycling, distinct from glass and fluorescent-lamp phosphor. Author-viewer OCR was available, but original graphics/PDF bytes were not acquired through the checked legitimate routes. Obtain and inspect the complete primary evidence before considering a separate CRT-phosphor owner.

Acceptance requires a documented legitimate acquisition with source identity, date and checksum; full methods/results/graphics and relevant supplement assessment; feed, controls, organism, outcome denominator and laboratory-scale checks; and an independently reviewed, history-tracked record change only where supported. If acquisition remains unavailable, retain the explicit deferral rather than infer claims.

The exact queries, attempted routes and access boundaries are retained in `research/sources/round75-crt/20261014T154702Z.{md,json}` in the round75 curation branch. This is a source-evidence follow-up, not a corrective finding against the narrower abiotic record. All 157 open and closed issues were checked across three API pages before filing; no matching CRT/DOI follow-up was found.
issue.title: Acquire complete CRT microbial studies before adding glass or phosphor mechanisms
